verdict.rationale: Luma's evidence shows generative video and image tools and multi-step creative agents that 'research, generate, and refine.' Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside the product. Agent research and generation is a different capability (adjacent), so it earns no credit, and an AI creative workspace could plausibly offer such suggestions, so the axis applies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
